verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical. Both shrink the SOLSTICE logo until it can't be read, and the 'NEW FLAVOR' badge ends up bigger and louder than the brand mark. The can is shrunk to a small icon, the body copy is tiny, and the subtitle sits on the edge of the background circle. The difference is the headline break. A splits it as 'Chase / the Light', which keeps the white/gold colour split clean. B breaks it as 'Chase the / Light', which strands 'Light' on its own line and splits the gold phrase across two lines.
